# form type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:formType`](gmeow-formType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/formType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lexicon`](../../slices/lexicon.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The kind(s) of a lexical form — written, spoken, signed, reconstructed, etc. NON-FUNCTIONAL: a single form may be classified as both spoken and written by different standpoints, or as both reconstructed and normalized in different analytical frames.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:LexicalForm`](../classes/gmeow-LexicalForm.md) -> [`gmeow:LexicalFormType`](../classes/gmeow-LexicalFormType.md)

Use [`gmeow:formType`](gmeow-formType.md) from [`gmeow:LexicalForm`](../classes/gmeow-LexicalForm.md) to [`gmeow:LexicalFormType`](../classes/gmeow-LexicalFormType.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to classify a lexical form's modality or analytical kind via a [`gmeow:LexicalFormType`](../classes/gmeow-LexicalFormType.md) value — written, spoken, signed, reconstructed, normalized, and so on.

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting a per-kind subclass (kinds are values) and avoid forcing a single classification — a form may be both reconstructed and normalized under different frames, so keep it non-functional.

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:formType`](gmeow-formType.md) at one or more [`gmeow:LexicalFormType`](../classes/gmeow-LexicalFormType.md) individuals; competing standpoint-specific classifications coexist on the same form.

### Examples

- ex:waterWritten [`gmeow:formType`](gmeow-formType.md) [`gmeow:formWritten`](../individuals/gmeow-formWritten.md).
